listing.summary: Explore Beetle Adventure Racing! / Beetle Adventure Racing! Recomp (danielgomesvieira2000) and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Keep an existing permitted copy
steps.instruction: If you already have a permitted, prepared copy, choose its beetle-adventure-racing-recomp.exe game executable and supplied working folder in the existing-installation review. Use your own supported USA Beetle Adventure Racing ROM in Load ROM. The reviewed release is an alpha; upstream reports a Linux boot crash. Existing Windows game data normally stays under LocalAppData/beetle-adventure-racing-recomp. Saving those launch details does not run it; launch separately when ready.

steps.title: Keep updates and data with upstream
steps.instruction: Retain the working folder and original game files. Follow the selected upstream version’s update instructions using a separate replacement folder. Portcove does not replace, back up or roll back this external runtime or its user-profile data.
